title: Without Delete, New Inventory Part creates only tracked parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit and See Financial Data but without Part Library & Inventory — Delete, so user B can create and edit parts but cannot delete them.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user B, so both users' screens can be seen side by side.
  • Use a part number for a new part, part A, that no part or Part Library entry uses yet.
  • Start window 2 on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. In window 2, click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Type a description in the Description field.
  4. Type part A's part number in the Part Number field.
  5. Pick any category in the Category field.
  6. Type 5.00 in the Cost field.
  7. Type 3 in the Quantity field of the bin row.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • New Inventory Part opens for user B, with the Track quantities and cost of goods switch on and greyed out.

Step 2:

  • The switch stays on: user B cannot make the new part untracked.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 4:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 5:

  • The category is picked.

Step 6:

  • Cost reads $5.00.

Step 7:

  • The bin row's Quantity reads 3.

Step 8:

  • The window closes and the part is saved with no access error: creating a tracked part needs only Create & Edit.

Step 9:

  • Part A's Total Qty shows 3 Available (a tracked part), not "Not Tracked".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S8-R7: “Creating a part with tracking off requires the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”
  • S8-R10: “Creating a tracked part needs only the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission.”
